author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: भूय एवेति । हे महाबाहो भूय एव पुनरेव मे परमं वचः माहात्म्यप्रतिपादकं वचनं शृणु श्रुत्वा तत्र निष्ठां कुरु । प्रीयमाणाय मद्वचः श्रुत्वा सन्तोषं प्राप्नुवते । अनेन श्रोतृत्वसंपत्तिरुक्ता । ते तुभ्यं हितकाम्यया हितेच्छया वक्ष्यामीति ॥ १०.१॥
translation:
The Blessed Lord said: Once more, O mighty armed, do listen to My excellent word, which, desiring thy good, I shall tell thee who art delighted (with My words.)
V. Excellent word: excellent because of describing the glories of God. Thee who art delighted: by this clause the fitness of the pupil to hear and learn is suggested. (1) 
A. The promised glory is described.
